notes: Background: Quietwater builds agent-facing overlays for mid-size telco contact centers; currently server-based rule engine + light LLM for summaries.
Primary ask: real-time, token-efficient streaming suggestions to live agents (SSE or gRPC streaming) with p99 suggestion latency <= 75ms and max tail <= 150ms.
Scale target: 800 concurrent agents at peak across NA regions, typical day ~6k concurrent-minute sessions, expected burst up to 5x during outages/promos.
Cost sensitivity: careful about per-token spend; interested in Optimize recommendations (batching, KV caching, quantization) to reduce unit cost.
Security: must have VPC option + KMS integration, SSO via SAML with SCIM provisioning, audit logs retained 1 year, data residency requirement for EU customers.
Model preference: prefer high-quality open models (LlamaX/Vicuna-family) but want ability to fallback to a smaller cost-optimized variant during spikes; strict guardrails for PII redaction.
Tool-calling: need secure function/tool calls into their ticketing system (Zendesk) and internal CRM; must enforce role-based access and avoid outbound PII leakage.
Quote from Head of Support (Lena Park): "If the suggestions lag or hallucinate, agents will turn it off. Latency and guardrails are everything."
Quote from CTO (Arjun Menon): "We'd prefer Redwood's Dedicated offering if the POC proves p99 latency under realistic spikes. Also need SOC2 + recent pen test."
POC asks: 2-week window, ~100 live agents, replay of 3 recent high-load events (promo days), baseline metrics: suggest latency p50/p95/p99, suggestion accuracy sample, token cost per session.
Security review status: questionnaire returned 2026-03-05; legal asked for SOC2 Type II PDF and encryption-at-rest architecture diagram (Drive link above).
Internal notes (AE): start canary with one region, sticky routing to Dedicated pool, enable prefix KV caching for common scripts, prewarm model instances before expected promo window.
Internal risks: their infosec has a hard stop on any vendor without ISO27001 or recent audit; Redwood team to provide attestations.
